policy: Official external-provider references and mobile app recommendations only. No live ratings, reservations, restaurant inventory, prices, dietary claims, promotions or payment execution.

additions.name: Burpple

additions.name: Chope

additions.accountNeeded: Provider account or booking details may be required; reservation and cancellation rules vary
additions.notes: Availability is not checked or booked inside SGBuddy. Grab Dine Out now handles many dining-deal offers; confirm changing Chope loyalty rules with the provider.

additions.name: treatsure
additions.summary: Rescue surplus food from participating Singapore hotels, eateries and grocers, subject to current stock.
additions.purpose: Hotel buffet-in-a-box and surplus grocery rescue
additions.accountNeeded: App account and payment for eligible orders; pickup or delivery conditions vary
additions.notes: Official treatsure site links to the iOS and Google Play listings. Surplus food stock, pickup hours and partner participation change.

additions.name: Jiak Simi? Food Wheel

additions.accountNeeded: No account stated on linked web tool; check availability
additions.notes: The wheel suggests foods, not verified nearby stalls or dietary-suitable meals.

enhancements.purpose: GrabFood delivery, pickup and Grab Dine Out offers
enhancements.summary: Grab's main Singapore app combines transport with food delivery, pickup and participating dine-in deals.
enhancements.notes: GrabFood and Grab Dine Out are features within Grab; discount and merchant availability vary. Booking is not confirmed by opening a provider page.

enhancements.name: foodpanda
enhancements.summary: Order from participating Singapore restaurants and grocery merchants.
enhancements.notes: Delivery radius, fees, promotions and times depend on address and merchant.

enhancements.name: Eatigo
enhancements.purpose: Table bookings with time-dependent dining discounts
enhancements.summary: Browse eligible off-peak restaurant reservations, with provider-advertised discounts up to 50% where available.
enhancements.notes: Discounts depend on time, restaurant and provider conditions. SGBuddy does not see live tables or book reservations.

enhancements.name: Fave
enhancements.purpose: Restaurant vouchers, rewards and merchant offers
enhancements.summary: Explore merchant-specific dining vouchers and rewards where offered.
enhancements.notes: Redemptions, taxes, service charges and cashback terms depend on each merchant. Do not assume GST/service-charge waivers.
